https://support.lendenclub.com/support/s.title: What is Lumpsum Lending?
https://support.lendenclub.com/support/s.content: The term ‘Lumpsum’ refers to a large amount of money. In lending, Lumpsum means lending a substantial amount all at once, instead of smaller, periodic amounts. With Lumpsum lending, you can distribute the entire sum across multiple loans of your choice in one go. You also make the full payment for the selected lending period upfront, and you can repeat this process for multiple Lumpsum lending.

https://support.lendenclub.com/support/s.title: What is the process for onboarding?
https://support.lendenclub.com/support/s.content: Registration: The user registers on the platform by providing basic details such as name, contact information, and other necessary credentials. KYC Verification: The user is required to complete the Know Your Customer (KYC) process, which involves submitting identification and address proof to verify their identity. Legal Authorisation: Once the user is verified, they are required to accept the terms and conditions, which might include signing a digital agreement. Activation: After the agreement is signed, the user’s account is activated, and they can begin using the platform’s services, such as lending.

https://support.lendenclub.com/support/s.title: What precautions does LenDenClub takes to recover the amount?
https://support.lendenclub.com/support/s.content: We assist lenders in the recovery of the lent amount through our internal collection team initially, followed by external collection agencies if necessary. This process includes triggering ECS to the borrower's account and engaging with them via calls, emails, IVR calls, WhatsApp messages, SMS, push notifications, and bot calls. Additionally, the borrower’s credit score may be impacted, and the loan will not be marked as open on their credit report.
